name: kimi_k3_mla_dcp_qrep_project_before_merge
changes: linear.py (on top of latent-down-mxfp4/linear.py): KimiMLAAttention builds q_b_proj as DCPGroupColumnParallelLinear when VLLM_DCP_Q_REPLICATE=1 (same switch as deepseek_v2), so each rank computes its DCP group's 96 query heads and MLA decode skips the per-layer query all-gather. ATOM 6611 D runs dcp_config.enable_query_replication=True

mla_attention.py: the FP4 BMM path supports query replication with a group-wide W_K (bf16 W_UK all-gathered over heads, MXFP4-quantized once; blocks run along the reduction dim, so each head matches its local quantization)

mla_attention.py: VLLM_DCP_PROJECT_BEFORE_MERGE=1 V-up-projects the whole group's heads with a group-wide W_V before the DCP a2a LSE merge, so the a2a carries v_head_dim (128) instead of kv_lora_rank (512). ATOM 6611 D runs enable_project_before_merge=True. Disabled per layer (warning) unless the FP4 BMM path and the NCCL a2a combine are in use

Local check (qrep-pbm/check_qrep_pbm.py, simulated DCP8 at Kimi K3 shapes): group weights byte-identical to per-rank quantization; project-before-merge rel. L2 vs fp32 0.1580 vs 0.1585 for merge-then-project; group absorption equals per-rank absorption
